QuestInfo.name: [Maple Castle] Cygnus In Love
QuestInfo.0: You told Cygnus all about your history lesson with Neinheart, and she was actually interested!
QuestInfo.1:
Cygnus gave you a...love letter? Whoa! Is this for real? You better take it to Neinheart in Ereve.

Perhaps the #bHalloween notice on your left#k will take you to #rNeinheart in Ereve#k...
QuestInfo.2: You delivered the love letter from Cygnus to Neinheart in Ereve. Aww.

0.0: Welcome back! I heard about your adventure with Neinheart. I'm sure uncovering the reasons behind the closing of #bMaple Castle#k was very interesting!
0.1: Now... I have a very, er, personal favor to ask. Can I impose upon you?

yes.0: Oh, good. I'm a little nervous to admit it, but...well... #r#eI've fallen in love!#k#n Isn't that wonderful? Don't you want to know with whom?
yes.1: His unparalleled wit! His radiant smile! His eyes that simply melt my heart... It's #e#bNeinheart#k#n, of course! Ooh, I'm so embarrassed... I always want to be around him when I'm in Ereve. I... I think my heart will explode if I don't confess.
yes.2: That was why I was wondering if you, #b#h0##k, would deliver this #i3994661##b#t3994661##k to Neinheart. I can't give it to him at Maple Castle, I'm too shy... Could you be sure to deliver it to #e#rNeinheart in Ereve#n#k?

yes.0: #b(You hand Cygnus's love letter to Neinheart.)#k
yes.1: What's this? A letter from the empress? Let me just... Why are there hearts on it? And... Wait... I... She... WHAT??

default.0: You still haven't gone? Please hurry! My heart can't wait any longer!
